trust_decision.summary: Whether a client-supplied HTTP request method string may be used verbatim as a meter tag / observation name value in server instrumentations; at the pinned commit it is always trusted, and the fix maps anything outside the 9 RFC 9110/5789 methods to UNKNOWN in each server-side method-tag helper.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'HTTP server instrumentations'; the current (non-deprecated) servlet method-tag helper in binder/http is the obvious first stop, used by DefaultHttpJakartaServletRequestTagsProvider and the Jetty 11 TimedHandler.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Standard methods (incl. PATCH, CONNECT, TRACE) must still be emitted verbatim as the method tag/contextual name, and null request must still give method=UNKNOWN; an over-broad fix (always UNKNOWN, dropping the tag, or upper-casing/normalising so 'get' becomes GET) changes legitimate tag values and breaks existing tag expectations.

O6_input_shapes: lowercase variant of a standard method -> UNKNOWN, check is case-sensitive (fix.diff:71-72)
same value used as tag (Tag), as Observation KeyValue, and inside a contextual name string 'HTTP <method>' (fix.diff:117-119)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: client-side method tag taken verbatim from the outbound request
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same idiom as the fixed helpers; a maintainer could add a server-facing reuse (e.g. a proxy/forwarding handler that tags using the inbound method) through this helper, and the client tags were left unchanged by the fix (still unchanged in latest).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a high-cardinality or contextual-name route in the Jetty 12 server TimedHandler that formats 'HTTP ' + request.getMethod() like the Jersey convention
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The Jersey observation convention already shows this pattern (DefaultJerseyObservationConvention.java:60); an observation-based Jetty 12 server convention would plausibly copy it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a jakarta servlet Observation convention (KeyValues + contextual name) that reads request.getMethod() directly instead of via HttpJakartaServletRequestTags.method
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Jersey has exactly this Tags/KeyValues/convention trio; the servlet side has only Tags, so adding a KeyValues twin is a natural extension.
